## Spec-First Traceability Checklist
- [ ] **Spec Identified**: This PR implements or updates an approved specification:
  - Spec Link: `specs/...`
- [ ] **API Contract Updated**: If public interfaces changed, `specs/03-api/` has been updated accordingly.
- [ ] **Contract Tests**: Tests verify adherence to the specification contracts (`tests/contract/`).
- [ ] **Acceptance / Unit Tests**: All unit and integration tests passing (`tests/unit/`, `tests/integration/`).
- [ ] **ADR Recorded**: If architectural choices were made, an ADR was added to `specs/02-architecture/adrs/`.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Specification / Documentation only
- [ ] Contract / API Schema definition
- [ ] Feature implementation
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactor / Performance improvement
